args.goal: With the RFP Generator AI chat panel open and a section already chosen, type a representative instruction into the chat textbox, press Enter, and verify that the prompt is sent and the chosen section changes as it would when using the Send button.

steps.note: Performs the Enter-key interaction and observes the prompt processing and resulting section update on screen.
Confirms the resulting screen has no visible crash, server error, raw identifiers, or invalid values.
